source_requirement:
Create a hospital management system.

Doctors can manage appointments.
Patients can register and view medical history.
Admins manage users.

data.project_summary: A hospital management system that enables doctors to manage appointments, patients to register and view medical history, and admins to manage users.

features.name: Appointment Management
features.description: Doctors can view, create, and cancel appointments for patients.

features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Patients can register and view their medical history.

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admins can create, edit, and delete user accounts.

user_stories.goal: View and manage personal medical history

assumptions: All users will have unique usernames and passwords
Patient medical history will be stored securely and confidentially
Doctors will have access to all patient appointments
open_questions: How will we integrate patient appointment scheduling with existing hospital systems?
What are the security protocols for storing and accessing patient medical history?
How will we ensure that only authorized users can access patient information?
